title: Moriarty successor ExactPlan and OutcomeIntent signing documents
description: PROPOSAL draft-2020-12 schema. Not frozen. Not registered. Host SHA-256 domains require majority and native compatibility before freeze. JSON Schema does not enforce hash preimages, cap sums, unique compound identities, or relational deadlines. Integer inclusive ranges are DomainValidation (pre-hash). Patterns use ECMA-262 (?![\s\S]) so a final newline, CR, or Unicode newline cannot match. StoredValue includes Rate and Price. StateBody.fields is the finite typed field registry. PolicyBody is distinct from PolicyBinding.

x-validationStages.structural: Draft 2020-12 schema including true-end patterns, closed objects, tagged unions, required-claims contains-exactly-once, action-specific if/then.
x-validationStages.domain: Pre-hash parse of every UInt64/UInt128/SInt128/Scale field against inclusive bounds; recovery alias; quantity vector; genesis predecessor emptiness.
x-validationStages.hash: Recompute SHA256(UTF8(domain)||0x00||canonical(object)) for every advertised digest from retained preimages.
x-validationStages.contextual: Cap sums, history, currentness, net-after-fees, clone, races. Specified-only until an evaluator exists.

allowedEffectSet.description: CoreOp constructors this residual may still invoke. Items are CoreOp names, not EffectKind names. DebtAccrue emits Accrual. DebtCreate emits DueCreated. Source action names live on OutcomeIntent.allowedActions. An ExactPlan action is authorized only if its CoreOp is in this set. Produced exactEffects must be in the closed image of those CoreOps.
Recovery CoreOp subset. Aliases remainingWork.recoveryRemaining. Does not copy a second Work budget.

x-coreSignatures.preconditions: from!=to; amount.value>0; debit(from,amount.asset)>=amount.value; amount.asset in allowedAssets
price.base==minOut.asset; price.quote==in.asset; dust.asset==price.base; in.value>0; outPredicate holds
x-coreSignatures.frameUpdate: debit in from actor to pool; credit out from pool to actor; remainder per F.2; writes named selectors

x-coreSignatures.preconditions: amount>0; balances[locker,asset]>=amount; no overlapping lock of same (locker,asset) exceeding balance
x-coreSignatures.frameUpdate: insert LockRight; balances available for transfer decrease

x-coreSignatures.preconditions: debt.debtId unused including tombstones; debt.principal>0; outstanding==principal+accrued; outstanding<=liabilityCap; matching debtCap
debt exists Outstanding; periodEnd>periodStart; periodStart>=lastAccrualEnd; rate.scale in 0..18
debt Outstanding; dP<=P; dA<=A after allocationRule; settlement covers converted nominal
x-coreSignatures.frameUpdate: P-=dP; A-=dA; outstanding=P+A; debit settlement; cumulativeRepaid+=nominal
P-=principalDelta; A-=accruedDelta; cumulativeWrittenOff+=amount; no token mint

x-coreSignatures.preconditions: source.holder==dest.holder==holder; source.vault != dest.vault; source.value exact; dest.value exact; two equal amounts at different vaults remain distinct
request.requestId unused; committed>0; filled==0; claimed==0; status Pending
status Claimable or Pending with filled>=claimed+already; claimed+delta<=filled
status in Pending|Claimable; claimed==0; requestId is the identity consumed by the retained winner if racing
x-coreSignatures.frameUpdate: status Cancelled; unclaimed committed returns; Claimed rejects

x-coreSignatures.preconditions: message exists unreceived; recipient matches actor
message unreceived; sender or recovery authorized
claim open; outcomeIndex in supported range
claim resolved; payout.asset matches stake asset

x-coreSignatures.frameUpdate: shareUnits-=delta; nominalBalanceUnchanged=true; does not erase Debt
entitlementRate=newRate; does not refresh work or authority

x-coreSignatures.preconditions: field in observationPolicy.requiredFields or declared observations
unborn fields empty; exactWrites cover every declaredFields selector; initial balances/funding/authority bound; predecessors empty
x-coreSignatures.frameUpdate: create declared fields from writes; remainingWork=initialWork-charge(Genesis); birth residualCapability

x-coreSignatures.preconditions: fromStateHash is current unconsumed state; Migrate in allowedEffectSet and entryActions; remaining conserved minus charge
x-coreSignatures.frameUpdate: programHash:=toProgramHash; caps/ledgers/duties/work conserved after charge; no mint

x-exprSignatures.eval: if cond=false then first-fail reject; else no frame change

x-exprSignatures.typing: selector in declared fields; value : fieldType(selector)
x-exprSignatures.eval: stage tentative write selector:=value; commit on success; rollback on first-fail

x-metadataResolution.rule: Walk with ancestor context. Price.mantissa unit is '{base} per {quote} at scale {scale}'. FieldBinding name debt_id makes the text leaf unit ObligationId, identity the leaf, role obligation-identity. Other leaves use schema x-display. Values equal parsed JSON leaves.
